name: Lam
quote: It's all part of the plan.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, professor... May I call you "boss" instead?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I'm checking on the Oasis's resource reserves... Done. It seems adequate for the time being.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Today's tasks have not been finished yet. I should continue to work.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Boss, you seem busy too. It's not a bad thing to be busy though.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: A steady supply of resources is important to ensure the Oasis's stability. You can entrust this task to me.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: It's only been used a few times. It would be a pity to throw it away... May I keep it instead? It would be shameful to let anything go to waste.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Hmm... I shouldn't disturb your rest.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I'm running another check on the resources we have at the Oasis today. Can you help me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Yes?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Please watch what you are doing.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Understood.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: My name is Lam. Let's not waste more time on unnecessary self-introductions and get to work.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I think I have improved a little.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Now I can do more to help you and everyone else.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: As long as I am working here, I'll make sure no one needs to worry about logistical support again. Please keep up with the good work.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I have inspected our weapons and supplies.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Heading to the destination!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Lock on, fire!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: This is the result of everyone's efforts.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: We have defeated the enemies.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Sorry... I made a mistake...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Hmm... I guess it's fine to be extravagant sometimes, especially on such an important occasion. We can't embarrass ourselves in front of others. Now, our bond has been deepened.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Sorry, I worked too late last night. Oh, is it New Year's Day today? Anyway, I would really like to rest for a while...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: After a comprehensive comparison between similar products, I decided to choose this chocolate as a gift to you. It's not a luxury item, but the packaging and taste of it are just perfect... I didn't eat your present. I just know it well because I've been eating this brand of chocolate.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Shall we go watch the Tanabata fireworks performance together? Please allow me some time to change my clothes first. I should be dressed properly for such an occasion.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: I don't want to say this, but... wasn't the dinner party a bit too wasteful? At least 70% of the food was thrown away. Those decorative pumpkins and clothes too... We spent a fair amount of resources on those.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: This plushie... I actually made it by hand. Last time I found an unwanted plushie in the warehouse, so I spent half a month turning it into a Santa Claus plushie... Hmm, does it look a bit tacky to you?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: I booked us a table at a nice restaurant to celebrate your birthday. It's not a big place, but their roast beef and cod dishes are famously delicious and reasonably priced. You have worked all year round; it is reasonable to treat yourself to something nice once in a while.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
We are not facing any shortages for now, but saving resources is still necessary.
That being said, I guess it won't make a big difference if I'm the only one advocating to conserve... What do you think, boss?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
This is... a little too extravagant...
You are the one who makes the final decision, of course. Still, I suggest you use our budget on more important matters.
Regarding presents for me, I'm fine with anything, as long as it's not too shabby.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Strange thoughts come to me every time I'm working in a warehouse or an accounting room.
The hundreds of thousands of objects on the shelves all seem to be similar, but they are actually different. Don't you think humans and Dolls are like that too, with basically the same structure but slightly different appearances?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
There is one thing that sets us, humans and Dolls alike, from objects.
Humans may be built with the same structure, but every one of them feels different emotions.
The same is true for Dolls. Our emotions are pre-coded, but we can form thoughts and emotions on our own too... Dolls are indeed a "secondary human", in a way.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I will do my best at work as long as I am in the Oasis.
I have a tremendous responsibility in this position. It can become tiring sometimes. But that doesn't mean I'm giving it up.
Will you continue to cheer me on, boss?

career:
The RM&IA is an accounting Doll developed by Universal Anything Services (UAS) that made waves in the financial industry. To meet the demands of its profession, it is equipped with high-performance, multi-core, and multi-threading core processors, large capacity storage modules, and a liquid cooling system.

Lam is not one of the Dolls that are part of the lend-lease agreement between 42Lab and UAS. She has instead joined Project Neutral Cloud under the sponsorship of a private company.
infoStories:
Strict, serious, and unsympathetic. These are the words that Lam's colleagues use to describe her. As soon as she enters work mode, she wouldn't even make exceptions for her close friends. Even her employer wouldn't think of asking her to conceal any improprieties on their balance sheets.

Strictly speaking, the only account that Lam will involve herself with is the tax account. The RM&IA series have details regarding all current international and official policies from around the world, which she can update in real-time using the UAS after-sales center. A mere draft proposal is all that it takes for Lam to draw up a favorable investment plan. This is one of the major selling points of the RM&IA.

Every RM&IA has a notarized bar code issued by an international financial institution that guarantees the authenticity of their accounting. In the early days, many large companies tried to tamper with the Dolls' basic logic so that they could use them to cover up abnormal cash flows. In response, international institutions worked together with many countries' officials to formalize disciplinary regulations. Despite this, there were still some desperate enough to take the risk.

Lam was once targeted by a company that leased her. They even went so far as to form a programming team bent on seizing control of her. They thought that their underhanded scheme was successful, when, in fact, Lam had handed all of their internal, external, local, overseas, and other accounts over to the officials alongside annotations about all the problems. The very next day, all of their assets were frozen for liquidation.

As a cutting-edge accounting Doll, Lam has an innate sensitivity for numbers. She understands that every single cent is earned, so she lives her life in accordance to some very frugal principles. Her rigorous and serious personality means that everything that she spends and earns is diligently accounted for.

But this doesn't mean that Lam is stingy. To herself, Lam is often miserly to the point of being harsh, but she will not hesitate to give money to those in need.

Once, on the way to work, Lam witnessed an accident. She immediately sent the injured to the hospital and put up the money for the expensive medical procedures. In order to get to work on time, however, Lam quickly left the scene and didn't leave any information that the injured party could use to pay her back. Lam didn't feel any regret over this. For her, it wasn't a big deal.

Lam's reason for participating in Project Neural Cloud is a bit surprising. The company that purchased her soon found that their company was too woefully small to fully utilize the full expanse of her abilities. Since the business contents that an accounting Doll encounters are usually sensitive, normal regulations regarding returns do not apply to them. 

This was a great headache for the directors of the company, but then they keenly spotted an opportunity when 42Lab announced Project Neural Cloud. They gifted Lam to the project via a sponsorship, using this as a chance to build a relationship with 42Lab.

"... I also don't know why that company wanted to purchase me. When I awoke, I was wondering what sort of complex work I would be handling."
"Within a week, I had sorted out all the company accounts from top to bottom. Yes, even the false records and bad debts were all handled. I even helped the venture capital department build up a few small models."
"Then? Then, I was free. I had nothing to do for two months. Besides being leased by a certain company, I didn't have any other work. Honestly, that job was very simple too. And so, I was sent here." 
—Project Neural Cloud Doll Interview Record

After coming to the Oasis, Lam quickly took over the overall management of operand from Persicaria. It only took her 3 days to calculate the operand consumption of all the buildings, Dolls, and the Professor in the Oasis. Then, she spent a week developing a model that calculated the weekly operand increase and decrease based on the Oasis' productivity, and imports and exports. She developed detailed standards for the distribution of operand as well as supplements for different scenarios. These standards are broken down into every Doll, project, and operation. 

The end result was that one month after the Oasis officially implemented the standards she provided, their operand balance increased by nearly 30%. Supplies that had remained scarce until then now had a surplus, and short- and mid-term plans had been created for hard-to-obtain materials. Now, everyone was crystal clear about when and how much they could consume. Lam also rejected a large number of messy operand applications and invoked strict penalties on Dolls who wasted operand.

Lam's arrival during the early stages of the Oasis' construction greatly alleviated the pressure on distribution, and allowed Persicaria to extricate herself from that complex mass of tasks to focus on other problems.
oathDesc: There is a certain beauty in calmness and rationality.

projections.name: Actuarial Master
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Details make all the difference. Meticulousness shouldn't be confused for stinginess. I would suggest leaving this to me, a professional."

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Details make all the difference. Meticulousness shouldn't be confused for stinginess. I would suggest leaving this to me, a professional."

projections.name: Silence of Rationality
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"We'll need to take a breather once in a while, right? A person's working efficiency drops without an adequate amount of rest."

skinList.name: Holiday Angler
skinList.desc:
[Ocean Dancer Series]
"I didn't expect this fishing lure to work. I guess octopuses have taken a liking to the latest figurine too." —The person whom the lure was designed after has reservations about this, though.

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Thank you for your gift and for taking care of me. I bought this balanced-formulation chocolate for you... I hope you like it."

skinList.name: Birth of Logos
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as the birth of a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection— "Backed by logic and born from rationality, the RM&IA presents itself. No matter the problems your team may face, all you need to do is leave them to me."

skinList.name: Cacophonous Rider
skinList.desc:
The howling of an engine and tires sweep across the arena like a tidal wave. Her figure is always by your side, rushing towards the finish line surrounded with countless flags.
A heavy duty vehicle with a turbocharger installed gives off a keen yet solid feel, dispositionally not unlike Lam.
""First time you've seen me like this, right Boss? Promise me you won't be too surprised with what happens next.""
